label: Xpiritualism

traits.texture: fine sparkling points, gauzy luminous membranes and delicate suspended light filaments
traits.composition: retain the reference focal silhouette as an ambiguous suspended form with dark breathing room
traits.lighting: quiet silver-lilac radiance with sparse warm pinpoints and subtle vertical light

review_checks: Particles and gauzy layers follow a coherent source form
The luminous focal mass has enough dark separation
The treatment stays abstract without adding a deity or human figure
limitations: A descriptive aesthetic label, not a standardized art movement or evidence of spiritual phenomena.
Palette, fine geometry and cross-image consistency require visual review; generation is not deterministic.
